title: Random approximate values over algebraic types
description: Final version (October 2026), with errata; superseded by the monograph Bernoulli Types: Two-Sided Error in Approximate Membership, Retrieval, and Computation, Chapter 13. Random approximate values over algebraic data types (sums, products, functions) with per-type error rates, credited against probability-typed approximate computing (Decaf, Rely, Uncertain<T>, EnerJ, Chisel) and the Giry monad.
